verdict.rationale: BILL Spend & Expense is a SaaS product with AI features, such as an Invoice Coding Agent, so letting it connect to external MCP servers is a plausible capability. The axis therefore applies, but nothing in the evidence shows the product acting as an MCP client. The only MCP evidence is a documentation MCP server that external tools like Cursor and Claude Desktop connect to. That is the opposite (server) role and earns no credit here.
